how_used: Second raster of the Fig 3 survey, used by the verifier to check shape.json (source ctx9): ticks read (4.2165 px/m), hue -> colour bar -> depth (open seabed NE -3.13 m CD = Fig 3 -3.1 m). Crest depths inside the outline (m CD, shallowest 5 % / median): west block -0.79 / -1.35, south arm -0.32 / -1.35, mid-top bag -1.11 / -1.58, NE lobe -1.04 / -1.49; deflated apex bags about 73 m2 at -2.0 to -2.4 m CD (median -2.26) outside the -2.0 m outline; 2013 bed plane z = -1.78 - 0.0131 X + 0.0098 Y (X east, Y south, m from the 376620 / 812980 tick), -2.4 m CD at the reef centroid. Goes to VERIFY.md (3D inputs check) and METHOD.md 'Inputs for 3D' annotations. Correction: this raster DOES contain a colour bar. 3D model (2026-10-07): the 1 m hue-decoded DEM of this figure is the "2013 survey surface (evidence)" layer of 3d/index.html (model.js survey2013, +-0.15 m), the reference for the inner (rise) profile of the reef, the crest check and the Navionics datum test; annotated/mmr_model_checks.png overlays the modelled sections (x = -20 and +20 m) and the model volume-versus-bed curves on it.

for_3d_check.result: 3D agent 2026-10-06: CONFIRMED the crest. Main-bag crest -0.8 to -1.0 m CD read off Fig 5 (west block shallowest 5 % -0.80, south-arm hot spot -0.33) matches the model crest -0.9 m CD (z = -2.03 m MSL). 2013 bed -2.4 (NW) to -3.3 (seaward) m CD is 0.7-1.6 m SHALLOWER than the as-built bed -4.0 m CD of the model (2008-09 vs 2013 state; Navionics 2026 reads about -2.75 CD): flagged, bed-level selector -3.0/-3.5/-4.0/-4.5 provided and the volume check shows the stated 2,800 m3 matches a bed of about -3.65 CD.
